title: SB0607 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-01-31; own version, official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513074245 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/SB0607.pdf; the last listed version was not archived)
provenance.note: Draft (as filed) dated 2025-01-31; summary says "As introduced", no passage vote listed, so no adopted amendments are missing. The LegiScan listing says the last listed version was not archived; this is the filed version. Section 2 deletes "unlawfully" from 39-17-1307(b)(1); Sections 5-6, 8-9 conform cross-references and delete 39-17-1308(b).

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (a).
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (e).
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1307): deleting subsection (g).
SECTION 7 (new TCA 39-17-1307 subsection): (1) It is an offense for a juvenile to carry, with the intent to go armed, a firearm.
SECTION 10 (TCA 39-17-1351(b)): (b) Except as provided in subsection (r), a resident of this state who is a United States citizen or lawful permanent resident, as defined by § 55-50-102, may apply to the department of safety for an enhanced handgun carry permit.
SECTION 10 (TCA 39-17-1351(b)): If the applicant is at least eighteen (18) years of age and is not prohibited from possessing a firearm in this state pursuant to § 39-17-1307(b), 18 U.S.C. § 922(g), or any other state or federal law, and the applicant otherwise meets all of the requirements of this section, then the department shall issue a permit to the applicant.
SECTION 11 (TCA 39-17-1351(x)(1)): deleting the language "twenty-one (21) years of age" and substituting instead the language "eighteen (18) years of age".
